cues.title: 兴奋先到电极a
cues.caption: 两处都在膜外，读数是两点之差。
cues.zh: 两个电极都放在神经表面。静息时，两处状态相同，电表没有偏转。兴奋从一端传来，先到达电极甲附近。这时甲与乙处的表面电位不同，指针才发生偏转。电表读的是两处之差，不是神经膜内外的电位差。
cues.en: Both electrodes sit on the nerve surface. Their resting states match, so the meter initially reads zero. Excitation reaches electrode a first, creating a difference from electrode b. The deflection reports that extracellular difference, not the voltage across the nerve membrane.

cues.title: 兴奋再到电极b
cues.caption: 同一束兴奋，先后产生相反偏转。
cues.zh: 跟住同一条颜色带。当它越过甲、到达乙时，甲已经恢复，乙正在变化，于是差值换了符号。两次偏转不是两股相反传播的信号。探索时可以改变电极间距；把两点重合，差值归零，但这不表示神经没有活动。
cues.en: Follow the same colored band. By the time it reaches b, the surface near a has recovered, reversing the measured difference. Two deflections do not mean two oppositely traveling signals. Coincident electrodes read zero even when the nerve remains active, because they sample the same location.

cues.title: 跨膜电位改变
cues.caption: 离子流改变电荷，电荷变化产生电压。
cues.captionEn: Ion flow changes charge and voltage.
cues.zh: 现在换一个观察对象：膜内相对膜外的电位。兴奋时钠离子通道的变化允许钠离子内流，局部膜电位升高；随后恢复过程让它回到静息附近。曲线是标明尺度的教学波形，不是把表面电表的读数直接当成跨膜电位。
cues.en: Now observe voltage inside the membrane relative to outside. Increased sodium permeability permits inward sodium movement and depolarization, followed by recovery toward rest. This is a declared teaching waveform. It must not be confused with the two-electrode surface reading from the preceding experiment.

cues.title: 信号到达突触末梢
cues.caption: 递质穿过间隙，电压不直接跨过去。
cues.zh: 来到两个神经元之间。末梢内的小泡靠近前膜，释放棕色递质示踪物。它们穿过突触间隙，接近另一侧的受体。这里跨越间隙的是化学信号，不是把前一个神经元的电位曲线原样搬进后一个神经元。
cues.en: At the junction between neurons, vesicles approach the presynaptic membrane and release the brown transmitter markers. The markers cross the cleft toward receptors on the other cell. A chemical messenger bridges this gap; the first neuron’s voltage waveform is not simply copied across it.

cues.title: 受体响应，再清除
cues.caption: 有递质，还需要受体能够响应。
cues.captionEn: Transmitter also needs a responsive receptor.
cues.zh: 递质与受体结合，改变突触后膜的通道状态，膜电位随之变化。接着递质被清除，作用减弱。探索中可以关闭释放，也可以让受体不响应。第二种情况下，间隙里仍有递质，却不能产生同样的突触后反应。
cues.en: Receptor binding changes postsynaptic channel state and membrane voltage. Clearance then reduces the effect. Exploration separates failure to release transmitter from an unresponsive receptor. With an unresponsive receptor, transmitter can still reach the other membrane without producing the same postsynaptic response.

cues.title: 金属连接的歧义
cues.caption: 出现收缩，仍需区分电的来源。
cues.captionEn: Contraction does not identify its source.
cues.zh: 回看生物电研究的历史。金属连接神经和肌肉时出现收缩，这是一项观察。但金属接触本身也可能引入电势差，仅凭收缩，还不能断定电只来自生物组织。下一步需要改变接触材料，让不同解释作出不同预期。
cues.en: Return to the historical experiment. A metal connection accompanies muscle contraction, but that observation alone does not uniquely locate the electrical source. Metal contacts can contribute a potential difference. Changing the contact condition lets competing explanations make different predictions.

cues.title: 去掉金属再比较
cues.caption: 去掉金属、断开通路，分别比较。
cues.captionEn: Compare no metal with no connection.
cues.zh: 再比较适当的组织接触，以及接触被断开的条件。无金属时仍然出现效应，说明金属不是所有这类现象的必要条件。断开通路又没有收缩。这里比较的是历史证据的逻辑，不是保证任意组织接触都会成功，也不演示动物操作。
cues.en: Compare appropriate tissue contact without metal with an interrupted connection. An effect without metal shows that a metal bridge is not always necessary. Breaking the route removes the effect in this comparison. These are historical evidence conditions, not animal procedures or a promise that arbitrary tissue contacts work.

chapters.title: 兴奋先到电极a
chapters.caption: a先变化，电表测到两点之差。
chapters.captionEn: Electrode a changes first, creating a difference.

chapters.title: 兴奋再到电极b
chapters.caption: 同一束兴奋先后经过，偏转方向反转。
chapters.captionEn: The same traveling excitation reverses the difference.

chapters.title: 跨膜电位改变
chapters.caption: 通透性改变，使局部电位暂时翻转。
chapters.captionEn: Changing permeability transiently changes local voltage.

chapters.title: 信号到达突触末梢
chapters.caption: 递质从突触前末梢释放，跨过间隙。
chapters.captionEn: Transmitter is released and crosses the cleft.

chapters.title: 受体响应，再清除
chapters.caption: 受体改变通道，递质随后被清除。
chapters.captionEn: Receptors alter channels before transmitter is cleared.

chapters.title: 金属连接的歧义
chapters.caption: 收缩是观察；电来自哪里仍需区分。
chapters.captionEn: Contraction is observed; its source remains a question.

chapters.title: 去掉金属再比较
chapters.caption: 去掉金属仍可收缩；断开接触，效应消失。
chapters.captionEn: Contraction can occur without metal; interrupting contact removes the effect.

bio-elective-1-027-1.label: 蛙坐骨神经的表面电位差实验

bio-elective-1-032-1.label: 伽尔瓦尼、伏特与生物电的实验争论

question.zh: 同一束兴奋，为什么让指针反向偏转两次？
question.en: Why can one traveling signal deflect the meter both ways?

lead.zh: 两个电极都在神经表面。先追踪同一条兴奋带，再核对两处读数。
lead.en: Both electrodes lie outside the nerve. Track one moving band, then compare both readings.

principle.zh: 电表测两处膜外电位之差；先后到达改变差值符号，不代表两股反向信号。
principle.en: The meter subtracts two extracellular potentials. Arrival order changes the sign, without two opposite signals.

question.zh: 如果把两个电极重合，零读数能证明神经未活动吗？
question.en: If the electrodes coincide, does zero prove the nerve is inactive?

explanation.zh: 不能。同一位置的电位相减为零；局部兴奋仍可存在。
explanation.en: No. A potential minus itself is zero even during local excitation.

question.zh: 为什么通道一变，电压就会变？
question.en: Why does changing a channel change voltage?

lead.zh: 从膜两侧的少量电荷差入手，再跟住跨越突触间隙的递质。
lead.en: Begin with the small charge imbalance across a membrane, then follow transmitter across a synapse.

principle.zh: 离子通路和电化学驱动力共同决定电流；电流改变膜面电荷与电压。突触递质另经受体改变后膜通道。
principle.en: Conductance and electrochemical driving force determine ionic current. Current changes membrane charge and voltage. Synaptic transmitter separately acts through receptors on the next membrane.

question.zh: 关闭钠通路，或保留递质但让受体不响应，哪个环节会失去原来的变化？
question.en: What changes if the sodium pathway is shut, or transmitter remains but its receptor cannot respond?

explanation.zh: 前者取消本模型钠内流驱动的电压上升；后者保留间隙递质，但没有原来的受体介导电位反应。二者阻断不同因果环节。
explanation.en: The first removes the sodium-driven voltage rise in this model. The second preserves cleft transmitter but removes the receptor-mediated response. They interrupt different causal links.

question.zh: 有金属时出现收缩，足以证明电来自组织吗？
question.en: Does contraction through metal prove the electrical source is tissue?

lead.zh: 先保留观察，再让“金属来源”和“组织来源”面对不同接触条件。
lead.en: Keep the observation, then compare contact conditions that distinguish metal and tissue explanations.

principle.zh: 单一阳性现象不能排除替代解释；适当无金属连接与断路对照限定了能推出的结论。
principle.en: One positive result does not exclude alternatives. Appropriate metal-free contact and interrupted connections constrain the inference.

question.zh: 无金属的适当接触仍产生效应，推翻的是哪一种更强说法？
question.en: What stronger claim is ruled out by an effect from appropriate contact without metal?

explanation.zh: 它反驳“金属是所有这类效应的必要条件”，并不保证任意组织接触都会收缩。
explanation.en: It rejects the claim that metal is necessary for every such effect. It does not guarantee contraction from arbitrary tissue contacts.

translations.离子流改变电荷，电荷变化产生电压。: Ion flow changes charge and voltage.
translations.有递质，还需要受体能够响应。: Transmitter also needs a responsive receptor.
translations.出现收缩，仍需区分电的来源。: Contraction does not identify its source.
translations.去掉金属、断开通路，分别比较。: Compare no metal with no connection.
translations.表面脉冲是教学形状，不是实测复合动作电位。局部膜模型给定门控时序，用离子电流积分: The surface pulse is schematic, not a measured compound action potential. Given gate timing, integrated ionic current and capacitance determine local voltage; full voltage gating, threshold and refractoriness are not solved. Two selected ions do not represent all charge; bulk fluids remain nearly neutral. Basal currents are included separately, reservoirs stay fixed briefly, and no pump resets the wave. Synapse and history retain their separate limits.
